text.p: Deprenyl Animal Health Inc said its shareholders and those of Draxis Health Inc approved the acquisition by Draxis of all shares of Deprenyl not already owned through a mandatory share exchange.

Deprenyl shareholders will receive 1.35 Draxis common shares for each Deprenyl share. The transaction will result in 5,725,188 Draxis common shares being issued, bringing the total outstanding to 29,240,161 shares.
In connection with the share exchange, George Darnell, a Drepenyl director since June 13, 1995, was appointed to the board of Draxis.
Draxis is an emerging Toronto-based pharmacetical company focused on neurological, dermatological and veterinary markets in Canada and the United States.
Deprenyl was established in 1991 to develop Anipryl for treating certain specified disorders in dogs.
